⚡ Dual-Stream Multi-Document Architecture
STAGE 01
Corpus Ingestion
PyMuPDF loops over all PDFs, extracting text while rendering 2.0x high-res page images.
STAGE 02
Multi-Vector Qdrant
BGE dense vectors indexed with full Base64 page images stored inside point payload.
STAGE 03
Corpus Retrieval
Qdrant retrieves the exact target PDF page and attaches its original visual PNG asset.
STAGE 04
Vision LLM Reasoning
Gemini Flash Vision reads charts, tables, and visual colors from the retrieved document.
📊 Engineering Trade-Off Matrix
Architectural Dimension Traditional Text-Only RAG Dual-Stream Multimodal Vision RAG
Multi-Document Corpus Routing Routes to document, but loses visual diagrams upon retrieval Routes to document and delivers full visual context to LLM
Financial & Hierarchical Tables Headers decouple from cell values; frequent drift Model visually cross-references headers and row grid
Charts, Donuts & Trendlines Discarded completely or reduced to noise tokens Reads bar charts, pie slices, legends, and line plots
Hallucination Mitigation High risk when queries involve visual document assets Near zero; answers are anchored directly to visual pixels
Storage & Compute Footprint Low (vector only) Optimized (text vector + compressed PNG payload in Qdrant)
